summary: Master ISO 37500 and ITIL 4 standards to optimize vendor performance. Learn SLA drafting, risk management, and SIAM. Enroll today for expert-led training.
lede: Outsourcing and SLA management helps professionals overseeing external providers set clear expectations and govern service delivery. The course covers vendor selection, drafting service-level agreements with measurable KPIs, and using service credits, risk reviews and governance reporting to address performance and dependencies across providers. Participants also work on transition planning and exit strategies to support continuity when arrangements change.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals who oversee external service providers and are responsible for the integrity of service delivery.
modules: Digital Transformation and AI in Monitoring
prerequisites: Participants should have 3-5 years of experience in procurement, contract management, IT service management, or operations. Familiarity with ITIL foundations or project management principles is highly recommended. No specific software is required, but a working knowledge of Microsoft Excel for performance data analysis is essential.
